description: This source file implements functions for a Web Resource Manager Page Manager Object, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization routines, as well as managing associated timers.

classes.name: BWRM_PAGE_MANAGER_OBJECT
classes.description: Main object representing the Web Resource Manager Page Manager, containing properties, timers, locks, and methods for managing web pages.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE BwrmPmoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new Page Manager Object, setting up its basic properties and method pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BwrmPmoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cleans up and destroys the Page Manager Object, freeing associated timers, locks, and memory.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BwrmPmoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enlists required internal objects such as timers and timers' clients, creating and configuring them if necessary.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BwrmPmoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes member variables and inherited properties of the Page Manager Object, setting default configurations and method pointers.
